say.8,490: eight thousand four hundred and ninety

scenes.name: DON'T TRUST, REPLAY
lines: A hundred seventy-five thousand files. Seventeen million lines. Not one comment.
十七万五千个文件，一千七百万行代码，没有一行注释。
Read one line a second, nonstop, and you'd need two hundred days.
每秒读一行、昼夜不停，也要读上两百天。
A referee would drown. A kernel never skips a step.
审稿人会被淹没；内核却从不跳过任何一步。
So don't trust us. Replay it.
所以，别相信我们——自己重放一遍。

scenes.name: THE 27-LINE CHALLENGE
lines: The contract, Challenge.lean: twenty-seven lines, importing only official Mathlib.
先看契约 Challenge.lean：二十七行，只导入官方 Mathlib。
It states five theorems, the Riemann hypothesis and four on Dirichlet L-functions, and proves none.
它写下五条定理：黎曼猜想与四条狄利克雷 L 函数陈述，却一条也不证明。
Main must prove exactly those types. Alter one symbol, and the match fails.
Main 必须证明一模一样的类型；改动一个符号，比对就会失败。

scenes.name: 8,490 SHARDS IN PUBLIC CI
lines: No laptop builds this in one go, so a planner cuts it into 8,490 shards on thirty-six levels.
没有笔记本能一口气编译完；规划器把它切成 8,490 块分片，共 36 层。
Each shard is named by a SHA-256 hash of its toolchain, its sources and the shards below.
每块分片都以 SHA-256 哈希命名：哈希的是工具链、源文件，以及它下方的分片。
Seventeen foundations unlock 529 jobs at once. Public CI publishes each finished shard.
17 块地基分片一落成，就同时放开 529 个任务；公开 CI 每完成一块就发布一块。

scenes.name: FOUR LINES FOR ANYONE
lines: Checking it yourself takes four lines: clone, step in, check the status, verify Main.
亲自检查只需四行：克隆、进入目录、查看状态、验证 Main。
Downloads come from public Releases: no GitHub account needed.
下载全部来自公开 Release：无需 GitHub 账号。
To test the path now, verify BuildAid.D1. Shards missing? --build-missing compiles them.
现在试通路径：验证 BuildAid.D1；分片不全？用 --build-missing 本地编译。

scenes.name: ZERO-TRUST FRESH REPLAY
lines: Why trust files our CI compiled? Don't.
凭什么相信我们 CI 编译出的文件？别信。
The SHA-256 check proves only that you got what CI published.
SHA-256 校验只证明一件事：你拿到的正是 CI 发布的那一份。
Trust comes from leanchecker --fresh: an empty kernel re-checks every declaration on your machine.
信任来自 leanchecker --fresh：你机器上的空白内核，把每条声明重新检查一遍。
Forge one proof, and the replay rejects it.
伪造一个证明，重放当场拒绝。
Then Audit.lean lists the axioms behind all five theorems. Only three may appear; a sorry would show.
最后 Audit.lean 列出五条定理的公理：只许三条，藏起来的 sorry 会现形。

scenes.name: SIX INDEPENDENT CHECKERS
lines: One kernel is one witness. So the proof is exported, an estimated seventy gigabytes, and judged offline.
一个内核只是一位证人。所以证明还要导出（估计约七十 GB），离线受审。
Six checkers rule: Lean's kernel, its paranoid checker, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron and lean4lean.
六个检查器共同裁决：Lean 内核、paranoid 检查器、nanoda、con-leche、con-ron 和 lean4lean。
In rehearsal, a wrong statement, a sorry, an extra axiom and a swapped proof were all rejected.
演练中，错误的陈述、sorry、多余的公理、被调包的证明，全部被拒。
On the full proof, that pipeline is still running. Don't wait for us. Replay it.
对完整证明而言，这条流水线仍在运行。不必等我们——自己重放。
